interpretation_rules: all signed effects including negatives are reported for every contrast; nothing is suppressed
an interval crossing zero means compatible-with-zero; it is not proof of no effect and not equivalence
practical equivalence is supported only by an interval wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon]
a regional plateau claim requires every adjacent contrast in the band to be practically equivalent AND raw r to strictly decrease across the band; a single equivalent step is not a region
no slack, fence, or H term is subtracted from an effect already measured as a global completion-time change
no best-start, best-block, repeat, or prefix selection; failed starts are retained and never retried under this frozen campaign
no model refit before or during the scan; locked-M2 predictions play no role in this analysis
raw r is route metadata, not compute time; padded/aligned descriptors are recorded per layout but contrasts are measured completion times
cross-capture map reuse (identity; one perfectly balanced map) is legal because the measurement unit is (capture, layout); reused layouts are never pooled across captures

statistics.adjacent_contrast_definition: for every consecutive layout pair along the frozen r-descending manifest order (identity, first-entry bin layouts, base), the effect T(earlier) - T(later); positive means the later (more balanced) layout is faster
statistics.cumulative_contrast_definition: for every non-identity layout L, the effect T(identity) - T(L); positive means cumulative gain relative to the identity placement
statistics.deadzone_rule: a plateau is supported only where raw r strictly decreases while every adjacent-bin contrast interval lies wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon]; an interval crossing zero is compatible with zero and is never by itself a plateau declaration
statistics.effect_definition: contrast T(a) - T(b) for two layouts of the same capture: start-level mean of the five paired within-block differences of completion_fenced_us_per_forward; inference across the four independent starts with two-sided 95% Student-t, df=3
statistics.plateau_operationalization: maximal runs of consecutive adjacent contrasts that each have delta_r>0 and CI95 wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon] are reported as bands; a band of >=2 contrasts is a supported_plateau_region; a band of exactly 1 is a single_step_equivalence and is not by itself a region declaration
statistics.sign_convention: positive effect = candidate direction faster; negatives preserved exactly
